# Eclyssia - API
This npm package isn't oficial see [Eclyssia](https://eclyssia-api.tk/) for more.

# Installation
```
npm i eclyssia-api
```

# Example
```js
const eclyssiaAPI = require('eclyssia-api')

eclyssiaAPI.blur('ImageURL')
  .then(data /* Data is a buffer */ => {
    fs.writeFileSync('./example.png', data)
}).catch(console.error)
```
